instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet, white walls, and a ceiling-mounted projector. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing left with her back partially to the camera, reaching her left hand to touch his right shoulder. The scene is illuminated by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
